problem_statement: Two accepted-ish cozy cream definitions existed without a single production gate: COZY_ART_BIBLE wall cream vs DNA mat_cozy_cream_leaf_v1. Human playtest also rejected a nearly-white uncanny body treatment.

sources_observed.authority_claim: Human-approved art bible; governs live P1E architecture materials
Recipe design theme referenced by real character recipes; not live P1E paint SSOT

comparison.cream_delta: Bible #fdf3e2 is lighter/pinker-warm wall cream; DNA #F7E9C6 is slightly darker yellower paper cream
comparison.leaf_delta: Bible #7fc98f mid foliage; DNA #78B65B slightly darker/olive
comparison.prior_silent_risk: Asset authors could paint from either source and both would look 'cozy' but mismatch architecture kit and prior U1 lock

rationale: COZY_ART_BIBLE already Human-approved and live for P1E materials
U1 style lock and U2 Nori package already bound body to bible cream + MAT_CozyCeramic
Character and block kit must share one world palette; architecture cream is bible
Rewriting DNA themes is out of scope (no DNA v1.2 / package rewrite this correction)
Nearly-white uncanny risk is addressed by multi-value cream treatment + darker joints/face, not by silently switching SSOT to DNA

rejected_alternatives.option: Adopt DNA #F7E9C6 as production body SSOT
rejected_alternatives.rejected_because: Would desync from live architecture wall cream and require DNA/theme rewrite authority not granted

rejected_alternatives.option: Average/blend both hexes into a third cream
rejected_alternatives.rejected_because: Creates a third parallel palette system forbidden by style lock

nearly_white_uncanny_remediation.finding: Nearly pure-white / featureless body reads uncanny under fixed 2.5D game lighting
forbidden: single flat near-white body without shade or joint contrast
